items.title: Procedures of Solution of Circuit Problems (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Procedures of Solution of Circuit Problems: a main subheading of 9.16 Kirchhoff's rules, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 215-218.

blocks.text: Is misal ke baad hum yehi tareeqa doosre complex D.C. networks par laga sakte hain. Kirchhoff ke rules istemal karte waqt yeh qadam uthayein:

items: Loops aise chunein ke har resistance kam az kam ek loop mein shamil ho.
Har loop mein ek loop current assume (farz) karein; saare loop currents ek hi direction mein hon, clockwise ya anticlockwise.
Har chune hue loop ki equation likhein: kisi hisse ko kam se zyada potential ki taraf paar karein to voltage ki tabdeeli positive, zyada se kam ki taraf negative.
In equations ko hal kar ke unknown (na-maloom) quantities nikalein.

blocks.prompt: "Poore circuit mein potential ki tabdeeliyon ka algebraic sum zero hai": yeh kis ka statement hai (MCQ 9.9)? Kirchhoff ke rules state karein aur samjhayein (comprehensive question 9.2).
blocks.explanation: Yeh Kirchhoff ka doosra rule hai: option (d). Pehla rule: kisi junction par aane wale currents ka jor jane wale currents ke sum ke barabar hai (ΣI = 0), kyun ke charge conserved (mehfooz) rehta hai. Doosra rule: kisi bhi band loop mein emfs aur IR tabdeeliyon ka algebraic sum zero hai, kyun ke unit charge cells se jitni energy leta hai utni hi resistors mein kharch karta hai.

items: Pehla rule (point rule, charge ki conservation): junction par ΣI = 0; I₁ + I₂ = I₃ + I₄ (9.44).
Doosra rule (loop rule, energy ki conservation): band loop mein potential tabdeeliyon ka algebraic sum = 0; E₁ − IR₁ − E₂ − IR₂ = 0 (9.45).
Signs: cell − se + par +E; current ke saath resistor −IR.
Example 9.10: R₁ mein 0.66 A, R₂ mein 0.44 A, R₃ mein 0.22 A. Tareeqa: diagram, loops, ek direction ke loop currents, equations, hal.
